Results 353/364 bytes; every variant keeps the directory block inline. Layout decided by branch prediction, not source order.

Original stores edge via shared 'mov %eax,0x58' tail for 1 and 2, immediate 0 for edge=0; candidate if-converts solid1==solid2 into setne. Variants: chain without returns, != order, solid1&&solid2 first, solid1==solid2 first, hoisted rotate=0. None matched (449/489/493/434).

Original keeps (blc*17 + 17) un-distributed and adds the doubled group after the gravity term; candidate distributes *2 (constant 34). Variants: separate sum *= 2 / <<= 1 / += sum, constant placement, statement reordering, sum=0 init, unsigned cast. All 671..679 bytes, none exact.
Candidate duplicates the is_down(ctrl) block after pos=num_posts (bb-reorder copy) and materializes return_value=0 differently; original does not copy. Not resolved by body edits tried so far.

Only difference is the position of the first fopen-failure log2file block (original mid-function after the fclose/else block; candidate near the end) plus one nop. Cold-block ordering; no source form found yet.

Original: directory==1 -> -1 (dec %al), sort block out of line via je, stricmp tail inline. Variants with ==1, nested/flat range, switch, early 'if (a->directory) return stricmp' all keep the stricmp tail out of line (122..128 bytes).

Original does not copy the outer loop header (jmp to a single condition after vol -= vol_step); candidate copies it and sinks vol -= vol_step below the copied condition. Variants (for(;;) breaks, closeButton in condition, <150, vol first, do-while, split conditions) gave 624..654, none 634.

Full reconstruction (recording: poll_control, dead/0x80 terminator records, cycle_count run-length, flags = control->flags & 0x93; playback: rec_pos-1 against demo->size; movement 0.7/0.3/0.9; rejump path) reaches 728/728 with register-role differences, but any form of it regresses the exact checkMenuFocus (emitted two functions later after startGameMusic/stopMenuMusic).
